profile.headline: Software Developer at Epic
profile.summary: Software developer on the Gallery team at Epic.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Software developer at Epic with experience working in patient registration, real-time coverage eligibility, and health information management.

positions.title: Junior Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote automated tests and documentation for ClickHouse's S3-compatible object storage feature.

Completed performance testing of ClickHouse's new S3-compatible object storage feature in a comparison between AWS S3 and MinIO, using datasets containing up to 1.3 billion rows of data amounting to about 120GB.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Led a group of 6 interns to complete a business whitepaper proposal for improvements to the Visa Rewards app designed to increase information accessibility and rewards utilization. 

Competed in a cybersecurity CTF challenge with several hundred other Visa interns, searching for webpage and server vulnerabilities such as XML injection, SQL injection, filepath patterns, etc. Finished in the top 40%.

positions.title: Math and Science Tutor
positions.description: Tutored students in grades 1-12 in subjects ranging from elementary level math and science through high school level AP Calculus and AP Physics.
